image-poster-product.label: 产品海报
image-poster-product.description: 生成适合电商和社媒传播的产品视觉海报
image-poster-product.prompt: 请帮我生成一组产品海报视觉方案，主题是新品饮料上市。要求画面明亮高级，突出瓶身、气泡、冰块和夏日氛围，分别给出适合电商主图、社交媒体封面和线下宣传海报的三个方向。

image-anime-portrait.label: 动漫头像
image-anime-portrait.description: 把人物形象做成精致的二次元风格头像
image-anime-portrait.prompt: 请生成一张高质量二次元头像，人物设定是短发女生，温柔气质，浅色背景，日系插画风，适合作为社交平台头像，整体干净精致。

image-brand-kv.label: 品牌主视觉
image-brand-kv.description: 生成品牌活动或新品发布的 KV 画面
image-brand-kv.prompt: 请为一个科技品牌新品发布会生成主视觉 KV，关键词是未来感、银蓝色光效、极简、高端、空间感。画面要适合发布会大屏和官网首屏。

image-social-cover.label: 社媒封面图
image-social-cover.description: 生成适合公众号、小红书或视频封面的图片
image-social-cover.prompt: 请生成一张适合小红书封面的生活方式图片，主题是居家收纳灵感。要求构图清爽、留有标题空间、色调统一，整体风格偏治愈和高级感。

video-product-ad.label: 产品广告片
video-product-ad.description: 生成适合品牌宣传的短视频创意
video-product-ad.prompt: 请生成一个产品广告短视频方案，主题是一款高端护肤精华。要求画面细腻、节奏流畅，突出水润、透亮、修护的感觉，适合 15 秒品牌投放视频。

video-travel-vlog.label: 旅行 Vlog
video-travel-vlog.description: 生成有氛围感的旅行短视频
video-travel-vlog.prompt: 请生成一个旅行 Vlog 风格视频，场景是海边城市的一天，从清晨海岸、街头咖啡馆到傍晚日落，整体节奏轻松治愈，适合社交媒体短视频。

video-character-scene.label: 角色场景视频
video-character-scene.description: 生成角色在场景中的叙事型视频
video-character-scene.prompt: 请生成一个角色场景视频，主角是一位未来都市风格少女，穿梭在霓虹街区和高楼天台之间。镜头要有电影感和动势，适合做角色世界观展示。

video-event-teaser.label: 活动预告片
video-event-teaser.description: 生成适合发布会或活动预热的短片
video-event-teaser.prompt: 请生成一个活动预告短片，主题是年度创新大会。要求开场有强烈吸引力，节奏干练，体现科技感、舞台感和期待氛围，适合活动预热传播。

trend-today-summary.label: 今日热点速览
trend-today-summary.description: 快速汇总今天最值得关注的热点内容
trend-today-summary.prompt: 请帮我整理今天最值得关注的热点话题，按平台和热度简要归纳，并总结出 5 条最值得持续关注的趋势。

trend-weibo-zhihu.label: 微博知乎热点
trend-weibo-zhihu.description: 重点查看微博和知乎的热榜内容
trend-weibo-zhihu.prompt: 请重点整理今天微博热搜和知乎热榜的热点内容，分别列出核心话题、讨论方向和可能的传播原因。

trend-content-angles.label: 热点选题角度
trend-content-angles.description: 基于热点生成可写作或可运营的内容角度
trend-content-angles.prompt: 请根据今天的热点话题，帮我提炼几个适合公众号或内容账号创作的选题角度，要求有差异化，避免只做热点复述。

trend-industry-focus.label: 行业热点关注
trend-industry-focus.description: 聚焦某个行业的重点趋势和热门事件
trend-industry-focus.prompt: 请帮我筛选今天和 AI、互联网、科技产品相关的热点事件，按重要程度排序，并总结每个事件对行业的潜在影响。

image-poster-product.label: Product Poster
image-poster-product.description: Generate product visuals for ecommerce and social media
image-poster-product.prompt: Create a set of product poster concepts for a new beverage launch. Use a bright, premium visual style and highlight the bottle, bubbles, ice, and summer mood. Provide three directions suitable for an ecommerce hero image, a social media cover, and an offline promo poster.

image-anime-portrait.label: Anime Portrait
image-anime-portrait.description: Create a polished anime-style profile image
image-anime-portrait.prompt: Generate a high-quality anime-style portrait of a short-haired young woman with a gentle expression, soft background, and clean Japanese illustration style, suitable for use as a social profile image.

image-brand-kv.label: Brand Key Visual
image-brand-kv.description: Generate a hero visual for a launch or campaign
image-brand-kv.prompt: Create a key visual for a tech brand product launch. Use a futuristic aesthetic with silver-blue lighting, minimal composition, premium tone, and a strong sense of spatial depth. It should work for both a launch event screen and a website hero section.

image-social-cover.label: Social Cover
image-social-cover.description: Generate an image for social post covers
image-social-cover.prompt: Generate a lifestyle cover image suitable for a social content platform, themed around home organization inspiration. Keep the composition clean, leave space for a title, and use a calm, refined, and comforting visual style.

video-product-ad.label: Product Ad
video-product-ad.description: Generate a short brand-style promo video
video-product-ad.prompt: Create a short product ad concept for a premium skincare serum. The visuals should feel smooth and elegant, emphasizing hydration, glow, and repair. Make it suitable for a 15-second branded promo.

video-travel-vlog.label: Travel Vlog
video-travel-vlog.description: Generate an atmospheric travel-style short video
video-travel-vlog.prompt: Create a travel vlog style short video showing a day in a coastal city, moving from morning seaside scenes to street cafes and sunset views. Keep the pacing light, warm, and cinematic for social media use.

video-character-scene.label: Character Scene
video-character-scene.description: Generate a narrative video around a character in a setting
video-character-scene.prompt: Create a character scene video featuring a futuristic urban girl moving through neon-lit streets and rooftop spaces. The camera language should feel cinematic and dynamic, suitable for presenting a character world and mood.

video-event-teaser.label: Event Teaser
video-event-teaser.description: Generate a short teaser for an event or launch
video-event-teaser.prompt: Create a teaser video for an annual innovation conference. The opening should be attention-grabbing, the pacing sharp, and the visuals should communicate technology, stage energy, and anticipation.

trend-today-summary.label: Today's Highlights
trend-today-summary.description: Quickly summarize the most important trending topics today
trend-today-summary.prompt: Summarize the most important trending topics today, grouped by platform and relative heat, and identify the five trends most worth continued attention.

trend-weibo-zhihu.label: Weibo & Zhihu Trends
trend-weibo-zhihu.description: Focus on top topics from Weibo and Zhihu
trend-weibo-zhihu.prompt: Focus on today's trending topics from Weibo and Zhihu. For each platform, list the major topics, the main discussion angles, and why they may be spreading.

trend-content-angles.label: Content Angles
trend-content-angles.description: Turn trending topics into content ideas
trend-content-angles.prompt: Based on today's trending topics, propose several content angles suitable for a newsletter, social account, or public content channel. Make them differentiated rather than simple summaries of the trends.

trend-industry-focus.label: Industry Focus
trend-industry-focus.description: Track trends in a specific industry area
trend-industry-focus.prompt: Filter today's trends to focus on AI, internet, and consumer tech topics. Rank them by importance and summarize the potential impact of each event on the industry.
